findings.description: Zero vector score returns null instead of 0. Requirement states 'Zero match → 0 returned' but implementation at skillup-data.ts:395-398 uses condition 'match.score > 0' which rejects zero. Test expects null (placement-zero-control.test.ts:16) but requirement contradicts this. Materials contain conflicting specifications: requirement says return 0, implementation returns null, test expects null. Requires Sol clarification on authoritative zero handling behavior before approval.
